description: UBM goal-setting conversation, formatting, deterministic validation, and Daily.md embed update flow.

phases.title: Goal type selection
phases.output: goal_type weekly|monthly|quarterly and execution date (bimonthly is accepted as a backward-compatible alias of quarterly)
phases.gate: goal_type in [weekly, monthly, quarterly] (bimonthly accepted and normalized to quarterly)

phases.title: Context and knowledge collection
phases.gate: required context sections emitted; missing external vault is reported as graceful zero-hit

consults.note: info-collector の Step 3 デュアルパス検索の追加経路。C06 knowledge-graph.json と C05 harness-artifact-graph.json を read-only 探索する。グラフ未生成時は skip し既存パスへフォールバック (graceful zero-hit)。

phases.title: Existing goal review
phases.condition: review mode or existing goal is present
phases.input: existing goal file and collected context
phases.output: 13-item review summary (basics 2 + camp alignment 3 + relationship building 3 + three-layer separation 5)
phases.gate: review summary is present or condition is not applicable

phases.title: Step 1-5 dialogue
phases.actor: run-ubm-goal-setting (parent dialogue owner); phase3-coordinator is an optional read-only advisor
phases.input: context summary, optional review summary, R1-R5 prompts, and optional coordinator next-question advice
phases.gate: the parent has recorded concrete answers for all five dialogue steps

phases.title: Template formatting
phases.output: Markdown file candidate in the hybrid structure with the 21 official blocks
phases.gate: every item of the output-formatter Layer 4 quality checklist is satisfied before deterministic validation (the item count lives only in that checklist and is not restated here)

phases.title: Submission section (monthly only)
phases.output: the same single monthly file opens with the submission section (all 21 official blocks, headings suffixed with （提出）) followed by the management section; no separate submission file is created
phases.gate: submission headings carry （提出）; submission action goals are one action per line without group headings; due dates equal the values back-calculated in the management section; or condition is not applicable

phases.title: Deterministic validation
phases.input: Markdown file candidate and goal_type; the quarterly / monthly / weekly files when they exist
phases.output: the raw rc of each script and the arguments used (not_applicable instead of an rc for validate-cross-level.py when the quarterly or monthly file is missing); the saved goal file, and only when an existing file with （提出） is found, that file moved (not deleted) to 05_Project/UBM/目標設定/archive/
phases.gate: validate-goal-output.py exits 0 and validate-goal-linkage.py exits 0 (rc=3 means nothing was checked and is a failure); when the quarterly and monthly files both exist, validate-cross-level.py also exits 0 (rc=3 is a failure; pass --weekly only when the weekly file exists); all within 3 formatter repair attempts
phases.commands_note: run every command and record each rc separately (no && chaining, so a failure of the first does not hide the others). Append --weekly <weekly> to the validate-cross-level.py command only when the weekly file exists. Skip validate-cross-level.py when the quarterly or monthly file is missing and record not_applicable instead of an rc.

phases.title: Daily.md embed update
phases.input: validated goal file path and UBM_VAULT_ROOT
phases.output: Daily.md embed line updated for the selected goal type
phases.gate: only the selected embed line is changed; non-vault or missing vault is reported without unrelated writes
